historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only InfiniBand class enumeration is not target evidence for an SCC Lockable Creg error and may be unrelated on some platforms.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly limits it to baseline collection and requires an NVIDIA tool/spec and topology map.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row113 covers an unspecified C2C Error. It cannot substitute for the named SCC Lockable Creg register/error mechanism.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The test first needs an authoritative SCC/Creg definition and register-level target; link inventory alone cannot preserve this specialized coverage.

original_test_intent: Validate the platform-defined SCC Lockable Creg Error on the intended NVLink or C2C coherent path, including exact detection, containment, coherent-traffic impact and recovery, once NVIDIA defines the missing mechanism.
original_method: Do not inject. Future method must define SCC and Creg, map the register/block to chip, peer and coherent link, baseline register/counter/link/coherency state, apply one vendor-approved synthetic error or lock violation, correlate raw target-specific status and persistent RAS evidence, then prove coherent traffic, memory consistency, peers and link health recover.
manual_activity: The NVIDIA coherent-fabric owner defines SCC/Creg and its lockable-error semantics, maps the exact block/link/peer, supervises one injection and validates coherent memory/data recovery.
required_inputs: Authoritative expansion and architecture definition of SCC Lockable Creg Error
Pinned NVIDIA coherent-link RAS tool/spec/version/checksum and supported chip/firmware/driver/OS
Exact NVLink or C2C chip/block/register/bit/link/peer target and access ownership
Stimulus command plus severity, latch/clear, containment and expected raw status/counter/log signature
Coherent traffic, memory-ordering/data-integrity, peer/link availability and timing acceptance
Independent OOB/console/fabric recovery, abort limits and complete register/tool restoration
safety_requirements: No injection or register write until SCC/Creg identity, safe synthetic method and recovery are approved
Dedicated topology with non-production peers, disposable verified coherent workload and independent OOB/console
Baseline link/peer topology, register values, counters, firmware logs and coherent data hashes without unapproved clears
One mapped target once; abort on link/peer loss, poison/data mismatch, coherency failure, fabric stall, reset or missing status
Capture raw latched evidence before approved clear and restore every register/tool/debug setting
agent_execution_scope: Collect only authoritative read-only NVLink/C2C topology, registers/counters/logs and coherent workload health when interfaces are supplied
Validate future SCC/Creg definition, target, stimulus and evidence contract
Do not treat InfiniBand sysfs as proof, choose registers, write/lock/unlock Creg, inject, clear, reset links/peers, recover, retry or assign verdict
engineer_actions: Define SCC, Creg, lockable error and covered coherent path
Approve exact register/block/link/peer, safe stimulus and severity/containment oracle
Supervise one injection with independent coherency monitoring
Clear/restore state, prove peer/data health and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Listing /sys/class/infiniband may reveal RDMA devices but neither proves NVLink/C2C topology nor identifies SCC Creg status; it cannot exercise or validate this fault.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep blocked until NVIDIA documentation defines SCC/Creg, the target register and supported injection; re-review the exact one-shot method and coherent-data oracle before execution.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The SCC Lockable Creg Error title, literal TBD Procedure/Criteria, generic before/after steps, Common branch and 10/10-minute estimates are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the vendor-defined synthetic path on one mapped SCC Creg target, capture raw register and fabric RAS state, and prove coherent peer/data recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: The source has no method; this adds necessary register, topology, severity, coherency and restoration dimensions without guessing their values.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic RDMA device listing or link counters cannot show an SCC Creg error was created, detected or cleared.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A control-register or coherent-fabric fault may have multi-peer effects and can invalidate in-band evidence or shared data.

project_override_considerations: Use NVIDIA-authoritative NVLink/C2C inventory and register interfaces, not Linux class-name heuristics. Treat the target as platform-specific until SCC/Creg ownership is proven.
expected_evidence: Approved SCC/Creg definition and exact chip/block/register/bit/link/peer map
Pinned tool/spec and baseline raw register, link/peer counters, topology and coherent data hashes
Exact one-shot synthetic error/lock event with synchronized register/fabric timeline
Fresh SCC Creg-specific raw status plus NVIDIA RAS/firmware/OS/BMC persistent evidence and approved containment
Cleared/restored register state, stable links/peers, coherent traffic, memory ordering and data integrity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title is specific but both Procedure and Criteria are TBD; no alternative source behavior conflicts with it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: SCC and Creg are undefined and no register, target, command or oracle is supplied. Even the component under test cannot be reliably identified from the source.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Define Reliability row112 Wistron-System RAS-00832-V002 SCC Lockable Creg Error: expand SCC/Creg and provide the authoritative NVIDIA architecture/tool/spec/version/checksum; map exact chip/block/register/bit and NVLink-or-C2C link/peer; specify safe stimulus/command, severity/latch/clear/containment, raw status/counter/log and persistent evidence, coherent traffic/memory-order/data-integrity criteria, OOB recovery, aborts and full restoration; require fresh review and do not use InfiniBand enumeration as target proof.

review_improvement: Identifies the missing register-level identity and rejects generic RDMA enumeration as evidence for a specialized coherent-link control-register fault.
independent_technical_reasoning: A named control-register error is only testable if the architectural block, register and ownership are known. NVLink, C2C and InfiniBand can coexist but expose different paths; a filesystem device list cannot establish the SCC target. Because coherent state spans peers, recovery must prove memory ordering and data integrity rather than only link presence.
